title: For each department in the School of Engineering that grants degrees, show
question: For each department in the School of Engineering that grants degrees, show the department name, the number of subjects it offers with at least 6 total units, the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for those subjects, and for each grade type, the running sum of total units for subjects in that department and grade type. Also, include a grand total for each department (regardless of grade type) in the format of (department name, null grade type, total subjects, avg, variance, stddev, running sum). Only consider subjects with more than 0 total units. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
         c.GRADE_TYPE,
         c.SUBJECT_ID,
         c.TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'
    AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND c.TOTAL_UNITS > 0
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE TOTAL_UNITS >= 6
),
dept_stats AS (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME,
         COUNT(*) AS total_subjects,
         AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units,
         VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_units,
         STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_units,
         SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units
  FROM qualified
  GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
),
grade_running AS (
  SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME,
         GRADE_TYPE,
         SUM(TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (
           PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE
           ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID
           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
         ) AS running_sum
  FROM qualified
)
SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
       NULL AS GRADE_TYPE,
       ds.total_subjects,
       ds.avg_units,
       ds.var_units,
       ds.stddev_units,
       ds.total_units AS running_sum
FROM dept_stats ds
UNION ALL
SELECT gr.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
       gr.GRADE_TYPE,
       ds.total_subjects,
       ds.avg_units,
       ds.var_units,
       ds.stddev_units,
       gr.running_sum
FROM grade_running gr
JOIN dept_stats ds
  ON gr.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME
ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, GRADE_TYPE
